scope: RTX 5090 pilot comparing deferred raw-page verification with text, visual, and equal-candidate-budget hybrid locators
prompt:
Question: {query}
Does this document page contain evidence that directly helps answer the question? Answer with exactly one word: YES or NO.

cheap_locator_depth_reference.warning: Candidate-hit reference only. A DVI-like verifier would inspect up to this many raw pages per query.

query_selection.stress: all queries where BM25 Top-20 misses every qrel page and visual Top-20 finds at least one

calibration.warning: No Pharma or Industrial threshold tuning is allowed.

metrics: nDCG@10 before and after VLM reranking
Recall@5 before and after VLM reranking

information_boundary.qrels: query selection stress slice and final evaluation only; never included in the prompt
information_boundary.visual_ranking: complete persistent visual-index baseline already built in earlier physical runs
information_boundary.dvi_semantics: BM25 candidates are inspected from raw page images and verifier outputs are discarded as retrieval state
information_boundary.warning: This is a DVI-like page-localization baseline, not a reproduction of DVI's end-to-end engineering-drawing QA or AgenticOCR's region parser.

continuation_gate.next_action: Only after passing, physically build 10%/20% risk-selected visual indexes and measure construction-query crossover.
